response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS total FROM scanfeatures), u AS (SELECT f.traitregistry, f.zoneref, f.articount, CAST(f.articount AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM scanfeatures f CROSS JOIN t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL AND t.total <> 0), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM u) SELECT u.zoneref AS site_code, u.articount AS artifact_count, u.share AS share, u.share - a.avg_share AS diff_from_avg FROM u CROSS JOIN a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (u.share - a.avg_share) IS NULL, (u.share - a.avg_share) DESC LIMIT 10
